tasks.title: Conversation #4
tasks.transcript:
MEN: Ms. Collins is considering restructuring the manner in which we acquire books for the library.
WOMAN: Why is that? Is there a problem?
MEN: Sort of. Take a look at this graph. The section with the least number of books is also the busiest because patrons are checking them out so much.
WOMAN: Hmm...We should definitely be spending more money in that case. How soon can we start purchasing more books?
MEN: We've almost spent the money allocated for acquisitions for the year, so we should wait two more months before buying anything new.
WOMAN: Well, meanwhile, let's compile a list of which books we want to acquire.

questions.stem: What does the man say about the budget?

options.A: There is little money left in it.
options.C: It will be increased next year.
options.D: There is enough money to buy more books.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问男士关于预算的说法，属于细节理解题，需抓住男士对“acquisitions budget”（采购预算）使用情况的直接描述。 选项分析 选项A：正确。 男士明确说“We've almost spent the money allocated for acquisitions for the year”，意思是今年拨给采购的钱几乎已经花完了，即预算剩余很少。 选项B：错误。 对话中提到的是预算几乎用完，并未说明今年的预算相比去年是减少还是增加，属于无中生有。 选项C：错误。 男士建议再等两个月再买新书，但并未说明明年的预算会增加，属于凭空推断。 选项D：错误。 男士说预算几乎花完，建议暂时不要买新书，说明没有足够的钱来买更多书，与选项意思相反。

questions.stem: What does the woman propose doing?

options.A: Rearranging the books in the library
options.B: Thinking of which books to buy
options.C: Giving a list of books to Ms. Collins
options.D: Looking for cheap books to purchase

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问女士提议做什么，属于事实识别题，需抓住对话末尾女士提出的具体建议。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 对话开头提到Ms. Collins在考虑调整图书馆的书籍采购方式，但女士并未提议重新排列书架上的书。 选项B：正确。 女士在最后说“let's compile a list of which books we want to acquire”，意思是整理一份想要采购的书籍清单，即思考要买哪些书。 选项C：错误。 女士提议整理清单，但并未明确说要把这份清单交给Ms. Collins，属于过度推断。 选项D：错误。 女士提议整理想买的书单，并未提及要寻找便宜的书来购买。
